title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
disclaimer: PackAudit AI provides AI-assisted compliance analysis based on pattern recognition and configured validation rules. Final legal determination requires verification by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer.

rules.name: Name and Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or the importer for imported packages.

rules.name: Common or Generic Name of the Commodity
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be clearly stated.

rules.name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) and Schedule II of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l, N, m) must be declared. Symbols must follow standard metric abbreviations (no non-standard symbols like gms, kgs, ltrs).

rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be declared (e.g., MFD: 03/2026 or PKD: 03/2026).

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: The retail sale price of the package shall be declared in the format 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price ₹ / Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP ₹ ... incl. of all taxes'. Individual unit sale price (USP) is required where applicable.

rules.name: Consumer Care Information
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(g) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number / toll-free helpline, and email address of the person or office that may be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

rules.name: Country of Origin (for Imported / Standard Commodities)
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(10) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: The name of the country of origin or manufacture shall be mentioned on the package for all imported or domestically packaged goods.
